messages:
Claire (AE): Heads up — Acme wants staging creds but asked for SOC2 artifacts, ISO network diagram, and a signed pen-test attestation before onboarding. Can we hit 48-72h?
Devon (SE): I can compile a tech artifact checklist. Quick Q: do they need the raw SOC2 PDF or a redacted pack?
Ravi (Security Eng): We provide SOC2 Type II report PDF under NDA and a control narrative. No raw production logs. Pen-test attestation uses our template; Legal signs.
Priya (Legal): I can sign the pen-test letter but need the final wording. Security to drop the template here and confirm redaction language.
ops-bot: Note: Dedicated POC provisioning lead time ~5 business days; Hosted POC can be done in 48-72h but no customer-managed KMS. Pricing delta ballpark +25% for reserved dedicated pool.
Devon (SE): If they require VPC peering and static egress IPs that's the dedicated flow. Also need their CIDR and test windows for allowlist.
Claire (AE): I'll request CIDR and confirm NDA for SOC2. Acme contact: j.santos@acmecorp.com.
Ravi (Security Eng): Pen-test attestation template:
```
Pen-test Attestation
- Customer: <AcmeCorp>
- Scope: staging environment, auth flows, API endpoints
- Date: <date>
- Summary: Third-party assessment performed; high/critical findings remediated or mitigated; detailed report available under NDA
- Signatory: Legal (name)
```
Priya (Legal): OK to sign once Security finalizes the summary line. I prefer "detailed report available under NDA" wording.
Devon (SE): Action items: 1) Ravi: post final template + SOC2 artifact checklist. 2) Devon: estimate infra lead times for Hosted vs Dedicated. 3) Claire: request CIDR, NDA ask, and confirm staging window. 4) Priya: prepare sign-off.
Claire (AE): Thanks — I'll update Acme and push for staging creds in 48-72h if they accept Hosted constraints. DM me for blockers. :thumbsup:
